purpose: Computes the Military Annual Percentage Rate (MAPR) per 32 CFR §232.4(c) and checks compliance with the 36% cap. MAPR includes all charges excluded from Reg Z APR: credit insurance premiums, debt suspension/cancellation fees, annual membership fees, participation fees, and application fees (credit card only). Bona fide fee exemption: $100/year maximum. Flags MAPR_EXCEEDS_CAP_VIOLATION when MAPR > 36%. DoD MLA rule (32 CFR Part 232), effective October 3, 2016.
